definitions.gloss: operation; service; running (of trains, buses, etc.)
definitions.explanation: The scheduled operation of public transportation such as trains, buses, and other vehicles along their routes.

examples.japanese: バスは{通常|つうじょう}{通|どお}り{運行|うんこう}している。
examples.english: The buses are running on their normal schedule.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}のため{電車|でんしゃ}の{運行|うんこう}が{止|と}まった。
examples.english: Train service was suspended due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}から{新|あたら}しいバス{路線|ろせん}が{運行|うんこう}を{開始|かいし}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: A new bus route is scheduled to begin service next month.

notes:
USAGE:
{運行|うんこう} refers specifically to the operation of land-based transportation (trains, buses, streetcars). For ships and aircraft, {運航|うんこう} (with a different kanji) is used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運行|うんこう}ダイヤ (operating schedule/timetable)
- {運行|うんこう}{状況|じょうきょう} (service status)
- {運行|うんこう}を{再開|さいかい}する (to resume service)
- {運行|うんこう}を{見合|みあ}わせる (to suspend service)
- {臨時|りんじ}{運行|うんこう} (special/extra service)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{運航|うんこう} uses the kanji {航|こう} (navigation) and applies to ships and aircraft. {運行|うんこう} uses {行|こう} (go) and applies to land transport. The readings are identical, so context and kanji are key.
